text:
maria: Heads up — after the egress gateway policy rollout in eu-west1, a bunch of pods with sidecars can't resolve external hosts (pypi/ngc/ghcr). model pulls time out.
jin: Seeing same on a few GPU nodes, ETA to repro: ~2/10 pods on a node. No change to node NAT rules that I can see. :thinking:
ashley: Envoy egress logs show CONNECT attempts but then 503 from egress gateway. Example log snippet: `upstream_reset_before_response_started` repeatedly.
samir: Can anyone paste the egress-gateway svc config? maybe we accidentally enabled `external_authorities` or wrong `virtualhost`?
maria: svc is `redwood-egress-eu-west1` ClusterIP -> headless -> envoy sidecar DNAT to nodeport. Policy is an AuthorizationPolicy that allowed only internal CIDRs + egress-gateway clusterip.
jin: I ran `iptables -t nat -L -n --line-numbers` on the node: nat PREROUTING has a CONNMARK rule from sidecar intercept, then a DNAT to nodepool NAT gw. Noticed packets to 8.8.8.8 get rewritten to 10.0.5.2:443 (NAT gw) but source stays pod IP. If egress gateway expects SNAT to node IP, replies drop.
ashley: Quick test: curl from a pod with `sidecar.istio.io/inject: true` -> times out. Curl from a pod with no sidecar -> works. So sidecar intercept+egress gateway combo is the culprit.
maria: Ops-bot, any recent change to egress-gateway Envoy filter chain?
ops-bot: deploy-bot reported a config push at 1769978000: added envoy filter `dns_pass_through` and a virtual cluster route for external domains.
samir: That filter probably bypasses SNI passthrough and forces HTTP CONNECT translation — breaks non-HTTP protocols and upstream DNS over UDP fallback.
jin: Workaround: annotate the model-puller pods with `traffic.sidecar.istio.io/excludeOutbound: "true"` — pullls succeed. Not ideal for production.
ashley: Proposed fix: revert `dns_pass_through` change and instead add a specific egress policy that allows `tcp:443` CONNECT to our NAT gw while keeping sidecar interception for tracing. Or add SNAT at the egress gateway so upstream sees expected IP.
maria: We need a mitigation plan for eu-west1 rollout: 1) rollback filter (if safe), 2) add SNAT rule on egress gateway instances, 3) temporary annotation for critical jobs.
samir: I'll open a PR to add a SNAT iptables rule on the egress gateway pods and a canary rollback. Putting a patch into `infra/egress-config` now.
jin: Also creating a smoke test that runs `dig +short google.com @8.8.8.8` and `curl https://pypi.org/simple/` from sidecar-injected pods in CI before future rollouts.
maria: Thanks. After SNAT patch and smoke tests, let's hold rollouts for 24h. Ping me in #incidents if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Created incident ticket I-2026-534 for tracking (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/I-2026-534)
ashley: Note for postmortem: call out interaction between sidecar interception, DNAT to external NAT gw, and envoy filter that changed CONNECT semantics. Those three combined caused the outage.
maria: Good call. Also add cost note: model pull retries spiked and consumed ~0.7 GPU-hours due to failed ephemeral container restarts.
jin: I'll follow up with a short runbook snippet for SRE: how to detect sidecar-egress SNAT mismatch and quick remediation commands.
maria: Great — looping in infra owners tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone.
